latest.title: Amazon Web Services (AWS): Exploring the Power of Cloud Computing
latest.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a leading cloud computing platform that provides scalable, secure, and cost-effective services such as cloud storage, computing power, databases, networking, and machine learning. This article explores the fundamentals of AWS, its key services, features, real-world applications, and its importance in developing modern cloud-based solutions. Learning AWS helps students gain valuable technical skills and prepares them for career opportunities in cloud computing and IT.

latest.title: Arquitectura RAG con Amazon Bedrock: Cómo conectar la IA Generativa con datos empresariales sin reentrenar modelos
latest.description: Este artículo analiza la arquitectura RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) y su implementación mediante Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases desde la perspectiva de un estudiante de ingeniería. Explora cómo conectar modelos fundacionales con datos privados alojados en Amazon S3 sin necesidad de reentrenar modelos ni gestionar infraestructura compleja. Aborda el uso de embeddings, bases vectoriales y privacidad de datos.

latest.title: The Intelligence Trap: Why Smarter AI Doesn't Always Mean Better AI
latest.description: As AI systems become increasingly powerful, an important question emerges: can we trust everything they produce? Explore AI hallucinations, overdependence, security risks, and the engineering principles behind building reliable, responsible, and trustworthy AI systems.
